gripOrHq.title: Startup Immolator
gripOrHq.rulesText: [T]: Pay the rez cost of a piece of ice to trash that piece of ice. Use this ability only if you have just broken all the subroutines of that piece of ice.

gripOrHq.title: Weather-to-Finance Pipe
gripOrHq.rulesText: Make a run on HQ. If run is successful, do not access cards from HQ; instead, the Corp loses [4].

heapOrArchives.title: Edited Shipping Manifests
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run on HQ. If run is successful, and the Corp has any credits when you would access HQ, do not access cards from HQ; instead, the Corp loses [1] and gives you a tag, and you gain [10].

heapOrArchives.title: Loan from Chiba
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Gain [12] when Loan from Chiba is installed. At the start of each of your turns, lose [1]. If Loan from Chiba leaves play, pay [10] or lose the game. You may trash Loan from Chiba at the end of any of your turns.

heapOrArchives.title: Priority Wreck
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run on HQ. If run is successful, do not access cards from HQ; instead, pay any number of bits to force the Corp to lose that many bits.

heapOrArchives.title: Core Command: Jettison Ice
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Play only if you made a successful run on HQ this turn. Pay the rez cost of a piece of rezzed ice to trash it.

scoreArea.title: Fetal AI
scoreArea.rulesText: When Runner accesses Fetal AI, do 2 Net damage, even if it is not installed. Ignore this effect if Runner accesses Fetal AI from the Archives. If Fetal AI is accessed from R&D, Runner must show it to you. Runner must pay 2 to steal Fetal AI, in addition to any other costs.

root.title: City Surveillance
root.rulesText: For each card Runner draws, give Runner a tag unless Runner pays [1], in addition to any other costs, to avoid receiving that tag. You may rez City Surveillance just before the card is drawn.

root.title: Setup!
root.rulesText: When Runner accesses Setup!, it does 2 Net damage, even if it is not installed. Ignore this effect if Runner accesses it from the Archives. If Setup! is accessed from R&D, Runner must show it to you.

root.title: Manhunt
root.rulesText: Play only if Runner attempted a run during his or her last turn. Trace 6-If trace is successful, give Runner one tag for each point by which your trace exceeded his or her link.
